### What Does Ezekiel 25:17 Really Mean for Us?
Author: Joel Ryan
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/what-the-bible-verse-ezekiel-2517-really-means.html
Passage: Ezekiel 25:17
Points:
- Pop culture famously distorts this verse to justify personal violence and human vengeance.
- In its genuine biblical context, God was speaking judgment against Philistia for long-standing malice against Judah.
- While God disciplines His own people, He also acts to defend and protect them from adversaries.
- Ezekiel emphasizes that vengeance belongs strictly to the Lord rather than to human hands.
- Christians are called not to take revenge or hold grudges, but to trust God as the only righteous Judge.
